name: Evolized
description:
About This Game

Evolized is a single-player, 3D top-down action-adventure roguelite where you are life’s last hope: The Seed of Life, a living creature born to stop a world trapped in decay.

Venture out from the safety of Sanctuary into a handcrafted biological world, split into three realms inspired by plant, animal, and fungal life. Each expedition is a new run, where temporary mutations reshape your creature, your combat style, and your chances of survival.

But the world will not wait.

A deadly Storm spreads through Eiegôr, making enemies stronger and zones more dangerous the longer you stay. When extraction becomes available, every run turns into a choice: escape with what you’ve earned, or push deeper for greater rewards before the storm consumes you.

Background

The planet Eiegôr is caught in endless extinction cycles, ravaged again and again by catastrophic storms. These disasters are not natural. Something ancient is controlling them.

As The Seed of Life, you must survive hostile ecosystems, evolve through mutation, and uncover the truth behind the cycle before all life is erased.

Key Features

  • Play as the creature
    Fight, move, and evolve as a living organism. Not a hero with a sword, but a creature built to adapt.

  • Mutate every run
    Shape fresh builds through temporary mutations that change how you attack, survive, and explore.

  • Out-evolve the Storm
    The longer you stay, the deadlier the world becomes. Enemies grow stronger, zones become more hostile, and extraction becomes a harder choice.

  • Risk everything, or extract to safety
    Bank your rewards when the chance appears, or push deeper for stronger gains and greater danger.

  • Roguelite runs, Metroidvania progression
    Unlock permanent Adaptations in Sanctuary to open new routes, reach new realms, and expand what your creature can become.

  • A world built from biology
    Explore handcrafted realms inspired by plant, animal, and fungal life, filled with organic threats, evolving ecosystems, and secrets buried beneath the surface.
short_desc: Evolized is a fast-paced evolution roguelite where your creature changes in real time. Build your biology, push deeper into a storm that escalates the world every minute, and extract before you are wiped out.
